title: Myopia: A Modern Yet Reversible Disease — Todd Becker, M.S. (AHS14)
summary: Todd Becker's Ancestral Health Symposium talk arguing that myopia is driven by near-work and can be reversed, covering the biology and epidemiology and experimental evidence for reversal by using weaker lenses.
why: HN commenters credit it as a life-changing talk, with some reporting reduced prescriptions after following the method.

quote.text: I'm super thankful to have found out about this life-changing video by Todd Becker on how to reverse myopia
